_comment: Machine-readable open-source allowlist. SOURCES.md is the human-readable companion with per-source license verdicts and citations. The allowlist validator proves every committed row's `source` is listed here and every subject/object code system is open. This is the structural enforcement of the UMLS/SNOMED wall.
